contracts_rationale: A bugfix inside the domain and storage layers: no HTTP path, schema, enum value or wire shape changes (spec C-001); only descriptive text in contracts/charter/schemas/Relation.yaml and a CHANGELOG line are corrected.
friendly_name: DRG tension edges and node fields round-trip
purpose_context: Epic #186 holds that open-packs YAML round-trips without loss of meaning (ADR-0036). The whole-pack gate found two DRG losses: #235, a tension edge (written in_tension_with) read as the retired signed impacts relation and written back as a plain impacts edge with no strength; and #236, graph-shard node tags and provenance and fragment node body_path dropped by the domain read and the shard writer. This bugfix keeps the tension relationship of ADR-0028 in the domain beside the structural relationships, writes it back as written, carries every declared node field through, and retires both expected-red entries through the gate's ratchet, with no HTTP contract change.
purpose_tldr: A graph shard's tension edges and its node tags, provenance and body paths come back from a read and write exactly as the pack author wrote them.
